content.comment_body: I'm having the same issue connecting [company_name] [product_name] with my PC. I use [article_no] [company_name] [product_name] and [article_no] cable. When I attempt to transfer from PC to [product_name], I get the message: Please check: -[product_name] in correct mode -The [product_name] PC cable is connected -Correct interface selected. The interface is correctly set and the PC cable is connected, so I think the problem may be with the device mode. Where can I adjust that mode? The [product_name] display is off and the unit is not connected to power supply. This is my first time using [product_name], so any guidance would be appreciated.
Hello, This might seem basic, but remember the device needs power to communicate. The programming cable does not provide power. Before proceeding, I recommend referring to the [document]. Regards,

For others who read this, I had a similar issue. The [product_name] displays: Program Card Setup Start. NOTE! >>> there is no PC option displayed! <<< If you see this menu, the device is not in run mode and you can upload from it. Ensure you are using the latest version of [product_name] software, as I encountered problems with an older version.

analysis.insight_summary: A user struggled to connect a [product_name] to their PC, mainly due to uncertainty about the device's required power state and operational mode. Replies clarified that the device needs external power and indicated that understanding setup menus and software versions is crucial. First-time users faced confusion stemming from unclear feedback when the product is not properly set up, resulting in unnecessary troubleshooting.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a straightforward connection process with clear, instant feedback or guidance for the initial setup, especially regarding mode selection and essential steps.
